seen.where: Union catalogue records https://catalog.digitalarchives.tw/item/00/09/52/8a.html (01-001, 41 pp.), /8c (02-001), /8e (03-001) and /90 (04-001, 119 pp.); the first-page images https://image.digitalarchives.tw/ImageCache/00/16/98/6e.jpg, .../70.jpg, .../17/ef/49.jpg and .../16/98/72.jpg were fetched by curl and viewed 5 Nov 2026; the full volumes are imaged only at archivesonline.mh.sinica.edu.tw behind a reader account (not created).
seen.extent: Only the catalogue's cover image (first leaf) of each of the four volumes (276 pp. in all, 'copy' version, undated) was viewed; later leaves were not.
seen.cipher: Viewed leaves: red-ruled Foreign Ministry sheets stamped 電報處 with headings such as '收庫倫陳都護電' (Urga), '收駐日本陸公使電', '發駐日本陸公使電', '收出使墨國顧公使電', followed by running Chinese prose; no numerals or code groups. These are decoded telegram copies, so the volumes record plaintext, as the lead itself suspected.

1378.note: First leaf of all four 密電 volumes (03-13-043-01-001, -02-001, -03-001, -04-001) viewed on the union catalogue images: each is a Waijiaobu Telegraph Office (電報處) copy of a decoded Chinese telegram in plain characters, not cipher groups.

seen.extent: Folio volume of 20 + 183 leaves: leaves 1-20 an unused register, the copies of the letters on a few leaves, ff. 31-183 blank; 28 Aug 1514 - 1516.
seen.cipher: Record, quoted: 'Ein geheimen Schriftwechsel des Rates mit einem durch die Chiffre "L und L" bezeichneten Kundschafter. Letzterer berichtet ueber die politischen Vorhaben der Fuersten und der fraenkischen und schwaebischen Ritterschaft.' and 'Auf dem Vorderdeckel Pgt.-Blatt mit Aufschrift: "L und L Nr. 1 anno etc. 1514"'. 'Chiffre' here names the informant (a signature), and the entries are the Council's copies; no encrypted text is described.

1621.note: Stadtarchiv Nuernberg B 11 Nr. 372 is a Kopialbuch with about ten leaves of copied letters whose 'Chiffre L und L' is the spy's code name (it is also the cover label 'L und L Nr. 1 anno 1514'), not a cipher.
